parsed.why: Lethal violence against trans women in largest city with recent dated killings, state impunity signals, retrograde push, and a court ruling destabilising protections; no trans-specific visitor border rules documented, and residents-facing law is climate only. Hostile society and weak implementation place it in high-risk band.

State policy of presentation-based detention, rehabilitation centres for trans women via raids, official framing of LGBTQ people as national-defence threats, and vigilante attacks on trans women in August 2026 with no effective recourse. Death in custody of a trans traveller. Severe state-directed exposure.

No traveller-facing gender rules documented, but sources are silent on border and facilities, so the score sits at the lower Elevated band.

Documented police and prison abuse of trans women, birth-sex prison placement without accommodation, hospital discrimination, and 2020s hostile prison policy. Hate-crime law and a first conviction for killing a trans woman partly offset. High-risk band with state-directed custody exposure.

Traveller-facing anatomy checks at entry, deportation and refusal of trans visitors, presentation-based arrest of visitors with custody and forced hormone removal, and criminal statute on gender nonconformity. Documented state-imposed universal exposure with no recourse; near-severe band.
